name: lander-call-software
description: Lander Call Center & Lead Management Software (Next.js + Express + Supabase)

scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('.next')) fs.rmSync('.next', {recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync('frontend/.next', '.next', {recursive:true}); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/public')) { if(fs.existsSync('public')) fs.rmSync('public', {recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync('frontend/public', 'public', {recursive:true}); }"

author: Ahmad Khan
